## Summary

Describe the change and why it belongs in the current scope.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] No automated step discovers or controls physical hardware

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] No token, private address, MAC, local path, proprietary app, copied asset, or unsanitized capture is included
- [ ] Protocol changes have portable fixture coverage
- [ ] Compatibility claims identify physical hardware and distinguish confirmed from unverified
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated when behavior changes
